LESSON: STANDING FIRM IN FAITH

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Church
Topic 5.3: Standing Firm in Faith

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Standing Firm in Faith
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why should you stand firm in your Christian faith?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. name the city where believers were first called Christians
2. retell how Stephen was stoned for standing firm in his faith
3. explain why they should not join ungodly groups

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: name the city where believers were first called Christians

Teach
• Today’s focus: name the city where believers were first called Christians.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

• Model B for “name the city where believers were first called Christians” using a home/county example.

Try this

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: retell how Stephen was stoned for standing firm in his faith

• Listen/read the idea.

Try this

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 3: explain why they should not join ungodly groups

• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

• Model B for “explain why they should not join ungodly groups” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "explain why they should not join ungodly groups" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: name the city where believers were first called Christians
• Model 2: retell how Stephen was stoned for standing firm in his faith
• Model 3: explain why they should not join ungodly groups

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: name the city where believers were first called Christians
2. Practise: retell how Stephen was stoned for standing firm in his faith
3. Practise: explain why they should not join ungodly groups

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Standing Firm in Faith.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should you stand firm in your Christian faith?
2. Why should you not join ungodly groups?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• name the city where believers were first called Christians
• retell how Stephen was stoned for standing firm in his faith
• explain why they should not join ungodly groups

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
